description: The hub's trends page as data: the weekly 'who gains, who is under pressure' calls (industries, business models, vendors and listed companies, jobs, countries) with their reasons, confidence, cited evidence and the date each call was first made, plus earlier calls; the fastest-rising use-case patterns by share of new deployments; and the news radar with a 1-5 strength rating. Optional lens or subject narrow the calls.

lens.description: Only calls of one lens: industries, business_models, vendors, jobs or countries.

limit.description: Maximum calls, patterns and radar narratives each.

subject.description: Only calls about one subject, for example Finance, Germany or Nvidia.

name: get_ai_trends
title: Read enterprise AI trends and who gains
